question: The actions of the Belarusian government to punish opposition by removing citizenship and restricting the possibility of obtaining documents abroad poses a serious problem for the hundreds of thousands of Belarusians who have fled to Europe in exile. These problems also affect their children born since moving to Europe, as they have no possibility of obtaining official documents or citizenship from Belarus.
The Council has rightly condemned these actions and reaffirmed its commitment to support Belarusian citizens in the EU through coordinated efforts1. 1.
Has the coordination among EU Member States identified any common approaches to addressing the inability of Belarusians to obtain official documents from Belarus?
Does the Council, in cooperation with the Member States, plan any additional measures to ensure that no children end up in vulnerable situations?
Council conclusions on Belarus as approved by the Council (Foreign Affairs) on 19 February 2024.
